## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue and accepted discussion.
Use `Closes #...` only for an issue this PR completes.

## Validation

List checks actually run and any skipped checks with reasons.

- [ ] Relevant regression tests and documentation are included.
- [ ] Generated semantics, skill, and MCP data are current.
- [ ] Compatibility changes have migration notes, or there are none.
- [ ] Required CI passes and review conversations are resolved.
- [ ] Visual changes were checked locally with `npm run test:visual`, or there are none.

Report vulnerabilities privately through [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
